# console-guide-catalog.tsv — the ONLY hand-written part of the console reference.
# The roster is not here. It is web/src/features/route-census.json, and the guide covers
# every path in it. This file exists for the gaps in the console's own translation
# catalog: a screen with no `nav.items.<id>` label or no `nav.descriptions.<id>` sentence
# in web/src/lib/i18n/locales/en/nav.json has nothing to publish, and a table cell that
# says nothing is a route the reader still cannot use.
# THE CONSOLE'S OWN WORDS WIN. Where nav.json speaks, the column here must be a single
# hyphen. That is not tidiness: it is how a description added to nav.json later turns this
# file RED instead of being silently shadowed, so the guide can never print one sentence
# while the sidebar shows a different one. Both directions are enforced — a path with no
# row and no nav string is red, a row for a path the census does not record is red.
# When you add a screen: put its description in nav.json (it is user-facing text and the
# console shows it in the sidebar, in nine languages). Come here only for the screens
# that have no place in that catalog — the pre-session legs, and the deep-link pages.
# Columns, tab-separated:
#   path         the route, exactly as route-census.json records it
#   title        display name, or "-" when nav.items.<id> already names it
#   summary      one sentence, or "-" when nav.descriptions.<id> already says it
